author: Yffe
content: Cycle-2 revision of proof-backends.md resolving critic findings #210 and #211. #210: replaced the hypothesis fuel-form with a concrete-registry form (exported file defines R_item:Registry with real-bodied spec-fns; theorem holds specs:=R_item fixed, quantifies env only over {ints,seqs,optres} via {v with specs:=R_item}), killing all-registries incoherence; registry population becomes an exporter-side HARD GATE (refuse-to-emit + per-name decide/rfl lemmas), no resolution premise; rewrote soundness paragraph per the critic's fuel0 analysis. #211: §7/REQ-9/AC-7 floor rules now incorporate the SHIPPED #101 equivalence exclusion (survivor and denominator both MINUS proven-equivalent), equivalence probe scoped as a §0.1 meta-query (F3). Also fixed 'spine spine' typo and restated cache_key precisely (4 args + CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION). Nothing the critic re-verified sound was touched.
